capabilities: Sync memos from a Memos server into daily notes incrementally
Format synced memos as list callouts, callouts, or Markdown lists with emoji timelines
Auto-sync on startup and at set intervals
Add local time records to daily notes without a Memos account
extras: README notes a compatibility fallback for Memos v0.30 time filters; the local time-record feature works without any Memos account.
intentEvidence: Inspired by the original obsidian-memos-sync plugin, this version offers advanced features
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull entries from a Memos server into daily notes with incremental sync and formatted output.

summary: Syncs memos from a self-hosted Memos server into daily notes, with emoji timeline formatting and local time-record entries.
